title: whisper.cpp Provider Options
description: Options for the local/whisper-cpp provider. `$defs/<task>` holds the schema for one task; the top-level schema accepts the keys of any task.

model_path.description: GGML model file within the Hugging Face repo (default: ggml-base.bin).

default_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code applied when a transcription request does not name one.

cache_dir.description: Overrides UNI_CACHE_DIR and the default cache location for downloaded models.
